retrievalProfile.description: A three-person group portrait featuring bold primary-colored blazers against a neutral background with a distinct vertical blue sidebar and script-based display text.
triggerTerms: trio in red blue and white blazers

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring three men in a staggered diagonal arrangement, wearing vibrant red, blue, and white blazers. The right side is defined by a textured blue vertical bar containing vertical text, while the main subject area uses a light, neutral stone-like background.
coreVisualRelationships: Primary color blocking (Red, Blue, Yellow accents)
Vertical sidebar balancing the group portrait
Horizontal rule intersecting the main title
coreInvariants: Vertical blue textured sidebar on the right edge
Subjects wearing high-contrast primary colored blazers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged diagonally from top-left to bottom-center, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man in the red blazer on the left provides the strongest color anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the red blazer on the left, diagonally down through the trio, to the vertical blue bar on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Light neutral space between the subjects and the blue sidebar.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral off-white background and white trousers.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red and Royal Blue blazers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow/Gold accents in the turtleneck and script lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in clothing against a low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a fluid, connected script with an elongated 'S' tail.
Secondary text is oriented vertically, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
Thin horizontal line intersects the script text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the main title features a long, sweeping descender that underlines the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid script for the artist name paired with a rigid, vertical sans-serif for the album title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, casual script feel of the main title.
Matches the heavy, condensed vertical text in the sidebar.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photo of three men in their 30s, smiling, wearing 80s style blazers in red, royal blue, and white. Arrange them diagonally against a light grey stone wall. Leave the right 20% of the frame for a textured blue vertical bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a yellow script title in the bottom right, overlapping the blue bar. Add a thin red horizontal line through the title. Place white condensed sans-serif text vertically in the top of the blue bar.

verificationChecks: Is the blue sidebar present on the right edge?
Are the blazers in high-contrast primary colors?
Is the main title in a yellow script font?
Is there a horizontal line intersecting the script text?

mustRedesign: Exact brand logos or crests on blazers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the trio is arranged diagonally.
Verify the vertical text is rotated correctly in the sidebar.
Check that the yellow script is legible against both the wall and the blue bar.
Confirm the presence of the thin horizontal divider line.
recipe.reuseFormula: Trio Portrait + Primary Color Blazers + Vertical Sidebar Layout + Script/Sans Pairing
